manifest_body.document_purpose: EVIDENCE-GAP acquisition freeze — precommits eligibility, source classes, contract-level field mappings, reconstruction/prohibited-inference rules, completeness/exclusion codes, planned count equations, schemas, O4-A/O4-B no-mix, and O5 locate-only protocol before any record selection, reconstruction, or capture

eligibility_window.end_basis: EVIDENCE-GAP-ACQ-AUTH-001 publication merge timestamp 2026-07-30T19:39:07Z (PR #571 / 29eece3) — exclude post-authorization observations; exogenous to data quality

source_inventories.policy: Pin read-only locations and snapshot-binding protocol without selecting observation rows or inspecting candidate content. Live mutable stores require acquisition-start capture of exact file/object SHA-256 before selection. Capture is not selection. Locations reuse prior sealed O34 inventory identities as administrative metadata only.

entries.read_only_location: Lawful local stores under prior Workbench authority: /opt/workbench/data/bar_cache and /opt/workbench/data/market_projection (concrete object Version IDs / tree SHA-256 bound at acquisition-start capture; prior O34 capture manifests are historical reference only and are not re-selected here)

Account-3 scoped persistence classes on authorized read-only host path /opt/workbench/data/workbench.sqlite (tables/classes previously published: orders, fills, accounts_state, audit_log, checkpoint/terminal package artifacts). Production stack b0058bf reference-only; must not be modified. SHA-256 of sqlite bytes or governed export dump bound at acquisition-start before any SELECT/filter/join for selection.
entries.snapshot_capture_method: SHA-256 of sqlite file bytes (or governed export dump) recorded in acquisition-start decision before any selection query

entries.read_only_location: Account workbench_account_id=3 / broker PA34USW0Q8UO paper records created under prior authority within eligibility_window; same sqlite host path as SRC-APP-AUDIT-PLAN-CKPT-TERM-001

Governing git design/evidence trees and any previously sealed Tier-A live-fill anchor manifests already published under ADR-0043 Phase-0 authority; locate-only after acquisition-start; no broker submit; no new fills
Repository commits and design artifacts listed in governing_refs
entries.note: Immutable governance pins only; not empirical observation rows

source_field_to_target_surface_mappings.mapping_basis: Defined from published archive schemas, phase0 Python contracts, and prior sealed source-class locations — not from candidate-row inspection

source_field_classes: quote payload bytes for plan symbol
O3.as_of_constraint: as-of <= reconstructable replay/decision time for the plan from bound snapshot
O3.reconstruction_rule: Deterministic projection into QuoteProvenance.as_dict and ProvenancedQuote; refuse string-only sources

source_field_classes: sealed checkpoint envelopes / binding tuples for account 3
O3.as_of_constraint: checkpoint must bind to the same plan/episode; content_hash required on sealed envelope
O3.reconstruction_rule: Deterministic load via checkpoint integrity rules; fail closed on incomplete binding or hash mismatch

O3.as_of_constraint: inputs must pre-exist in bound snapshot; no post-hoc invention of fees/prices
O3.reconstruction_rule: Deterministic assembly of FillLeg sequence + policy dict sufficient for compute_canonical_loss

source_field_classes: terminal/crash-consistency packages and durable journal records for the plan/run
O3.as_of_constraint: package must already exist at frozen source cutoff
O3.reconstruction_rule: Deterministic projection to TerminalPackage.as_dict; lineage must prove package pre-existed in snapshot

O3.target_contract: order/plan authority dict retained from O34 family
O3.reconstruction_rule: Deterministic projection; must remain account-3 scoped
plan_id=ord:<orders.id> unless superseding contract amended into a future freeze

source_field_classes: two-sided quotes for intended symbols at or before cutoff
O4_A.reconstruction_rule: Deterministic selection of last eligible two-sided quote at/before cutoff from bound market stores; empty book → exclude MISSING_DECISION_TIME_QUOTE

source_field_classes: decision-time model-availability flag recorded for the plan
O4_A.as_of_constraint: at decision time / at or before cutoff
O4_A.reconstruction_rule: Emit explicit boolean from pre-existing record; absence → exclude MISSING_PROVENANCE (do not default true)

source_field_classes: orders.submitted_at or first broker submission attempt attributable to plan; else last pre-submit decision event
O4_A.reconstruction_rule: Same family as O34-ACQ-FREEZE-001 o4a_cutoff_rule; unreconstructable → MISSING_CUTOFF

O4_A.target_contract: EVGAP O4-A schema fills maxItems=0; terminal/post_submit null
O4_A.reconstruction_rule: fills must be empty; terminal_broker_state and post_submit_quotes must be null; day_change on O4-A rows must remain null (forensic baseline belongs to O4-B)
prohibited_inference: any O4-B payload merge into O4-A

source_field_classes: account-3 broker equity / day P&L fields (accounts_state.raw_payload or governed equivalent) at forensic as-of
O4_B.as_of_constraint: forensic as-of for the episode; provenance must record baseline_mode and as_of_utc
O4_B.reconstruction_rule: Deterministic extraction of decimal day_change under bound baseline mode; null/absent → MISSING_FORENSIC_BASELINE (not QUALIFIED for O4-B gate binding unless freeze-accepted equivalent present)
prohibited_inference: later equity marks after forensic as-of

O5.target_contract: EVIDENCE-GAP-001 §7 Tier-A anchors[] with identity + SHA-256 + provenance
source_field_classes: pre-existing sealed Tier-A live-fill anchor manifests
O5.as_of_constraint: anchor must pre-exist; no new fills
O5.reconstruction_rule: Locate and qualify only after acquisition-start; anchors:[] is a valid outcome

inclusion_rules.description: Include account-3 (workbench_account_id=3, broker PA34USW0Q8UO) order/plan episodes with plan_created_at_utc (or orders.created_at equivalent) in eligibility_window
Include only records whose source_lineage resolves to a source_id in source_inventories.entries with successful snapshot binding at acquisition-start
O4-A rows may include only fields available at or before FIRST_BROKER_SUBMISSION_BOUNDARY for that episode
O4-B rows may include only episodes meeting O4B-TERM-COMPLETE-001 plus forensic baseline rule when emitting QUALIFIED-bindable rows
O3 QUALIFIED-bindable rows require all replay surfaces non-null: quote_provenance, authority_inputs, checkpoint_tuple, loss_accounting_inputs, recovery_inputs

exclusion_rules.description: Exclude WP7 hermetic fixtures and inline KOKU / obs-a / obs-b / arc-1 test identities
Exclude phase0_o4_replay.py hermetic inline fixtures as empirical observations
Exclude WP0 seal 20260729T161843Z production ops snapshot as O3/O4 empirical corpus
Exclude ADR 0048 SEP/ACTIONS corpus and other non-ADR0043 Phase-0 programs
Exclude adr0043_gate_replay_v1.0 CI PR replay artifacts
Exclude acct7/v13 journals and wrong-purpose research program evidence
Exclude Option 2A hermetic CORR-06/O1/O2 evidence root as O3/O4 empirical observations
Exclude unit-test fixtures and synthetic examples converted to empirical rows
Exclude non-account-3 events; exclude post-window records; exclude manufactured sample-size fillers
Exclude production OrderRouter live path observation on deployed commit b0058bf
Exclude mutation/reuse of QUAL-001 archive IDs O3/O4A/O4B-CAND-20260730T022316Z; those remain immutable historical evidence
Exclude CAMPAIGN v1.2 run evidence root docs/design/evidence/dbox_campaign_v1_2_run_001/ as an empirical acquisition source (reference dispositions only)
Exclude fabricating gap surfaces from O34 constructed archives that systematically null those surfaces

unit_of_observation.definition: One order/plan episode (plan_id=ord:<orders.id>) for account 3 within eligibility_window
unit_of_observation.o3_mapping: One O3 observation row per included plan_id after dedup
unit_of_observation.o4a_mapping: One O4-A observation row per included plan_id with reconstructable FIRST_BROKER_SUBMISSION_BOUNDARY cutoff
unit_of_observation.o4b_mapping: One O4-B observation row per included plan_id meeting terminal completeness; linked to same episode_id as O4-A without payload merge

symbol_session_clustering.independence_assumption: Plans in the same symbol-session cluster are positively dependent; report n_raw and n_eff<=n_raw
symbol_session_clustering.counting_policy: Emit both raw observation counts and cluster counts; sample sufficiency must not invent new observations

o4a_cutoff_rule.reconstruction_method: For each plan_id, reconstruct cutoff_at_utc as the timestamp of the first broker submission attempt/order event attributable to that plan from audit/order/terminal records in the bound source snapshot (orders.submitted_at family); if no submission occurred, cutoff is the last pre-submit decision event recorded for the plan; if neither can be reconstructed → exclude MISSING_CUTOFF (do not invent)

criteria: Non-empty fills array for the episode
Terminal loss/accounting inputs present or explicitly reason-coded as unavailable with FAIL_CLOSED exclusion
Episode linkage to O4-A episode_id without merging O4-A/O4-B payloads
o4b_terminal_completeness_rule.forensic_baseline_for_qualified_binding: Non-null day_change (or freeze-accepted equivalent with baseline_mode + as_of_utc provenance) required for QUALIFIED O4-B gate binding
o4b_terminal_completeness_rule.incomplete_observation_treatment: EXCLUDE_WITH_REASON_CODE_O4B_INCOMPLETE or MISSING_FORENSIC_BASELINE; if exclusion would require manufacturing replacements → STOP_INCONCLUSIVE

completeness_criteria.O3_QUALIFIED_BINDABLE: All of quote_provenance, authority_inputs, checkpoint_tuple, loss_accounting_inputs, recovery_inputs non-null and contract-valid
completeness_criteria.O4A_QUALIFIED_BINDABLE: Reconstructable cutoff; non-empty two-sided decision-time quotes per intended symbol with freshness; explicit model_available; fills empty; no O4-B fields
completeness_criteria.O4B_QUALIFIED_BINDABLE: O4B-TERM-COMPLETE-001 plus non-null day_change (or accepted equivalent) with baseline provenance
completeness_criteria.O5: Tier-A anchors located and qualified, or anchors:[] valid

permitted_transformations.description: Deterministic field projection/normalization to EVGAP target archive schemas
Deterministic joins on precommitted keys (plan_id, episode_id, account_id)
Deterministic classification into separate O3 / O4-A / O4-B pipelines per freeze rules
Deterministic archive packaging (canonical JSON bytes) and SHA-256 computation
O5 locate-only enumeration of pre-existing sealed Tier-A anchor manifests after acquisition-start

prohibited_substitutions: Manufacturing observations to satisfy sample size
Converting unit-test fixtures or synthetic examples into empirical observations
Silent import of another research program evidence
Generating new orders, fills, attempts, or sessions
Outcome-conditioned rewrite of eligibility or sampling rules after inspection
Mixing O4-A and O4-B payloads into one archive
Synthesizing quotes, checkpoints, loss inputs, recovery state, or day_change from assumptions
Using later market data as decision-time quotes
Filling missing surfaces from evaluator defaults
Mutating or reusing QUAL-001 archive IDs
Prospective instrumentation creating a new evidence population under this freeze

expected_count_reconciliation.policy: Planned equations only; numeric empirical counts are NOT_APPLICABLE_BEFORE_SELECTION and must be filled only after acquisition-start selection; must reconcile or STOP

formulas.n_source_count: COUNT distinct source_row_key on bound snapshots before window filter
formulas.n_window_eligible: COUNT after eligibility_window and INC/EXC filters
formulas.n_deduplicated: COUNT after deduplication keys with FAIL_CLOSED on collision
formulas.n_complete_o3: COUNT O3 rows meeting O3_QUALIFIED_BINDABLE completeness
formulas.n_complete_o4a: COUNT O4-A rows meeting O4A_QUALIFIED_BINDABLE completeness
formulas.n_complete_o4b: COUNT O4-B rows meeting O4B_QUALIFIED_BINDABLE completeness
formulas.n_excluded_by_reason: SUM of reason-coded exclusions at each stage
formulas.n_emitted_o3: COUNT O3 rows written to new EVGAP archive
formulas.n_emitted_o4a: COUNT O4-A rows written to new EVGAP archive
formulas.n_emitted_o4b: COUNT O4-B rows written to new EVGAP archive
formulas.identity: source_count → window_eligible → deduplicated; complete + excluded_by_reason must equal prior stage; emitted ⊆ complete

storage_paths.s3_policy: Optional S3 pin only after CONSTRUCTED; must include Version ID + SHA-256 fail-closed; no unpinned latest

archive_outcomes.CONSTRUCTED: Candidate archive bytes + hashes under this freeze
archive_outcomes.INCONCLUSIVE: Stop condition or empty eligible set including valid O5 anchors:[]
archive_outcomes.gate_ready_requires: QUALIFIED plus later campaign scope/freeze/start — not automatic from CONSTRUCTED

qualification_criteria.independent_role: Qualifier must be a separate operator/session from the constructor; constructor may not self-qualify

broker_reads.policy: None by default. Read-only broker history only if separately declared here and proven side-effect-free before use.

tooling_identities.extraction_packaging_code: NOT_YET_PRESENT — may be developed under ACQ-AUTH-001 with synthetic fixtures only before acquisition-start; empirical extractors must be commit-pinned in acquisition-start before use
tooling_identities.synthetic_fixtures_policy: Allowed for tooling tests only; EXC-009 excludes them from empirical evidence

stop_conditions: Required source snapshot unavailable or unpinnable
Decision-time cutoff cannot be reconstructed without invention
Terminal/forensic completeness cannot be established without fabrication
Source records modified after bound snapshot
Broker calls beyond authorized reads required
Sample sufficiency would require generating new observations
Gap surface recovery would require prohibited inference
Ambiguous lineage for any emitted row
Mapping cannot be executed without guessing unresolved sources

predetermined_inconclusive_handling.on_stop_condition: Close acquisition/construction INCONCLUSIVE or require superseding freeze + owner acknowledgment; do not invent observations

rule_change_policy.after_outcome_inspection: FORBIDDEN without superseding freeze manifest and owner acknowledgment

seal.post_seal_state: SEALED — acquisition-start, snapshot capture, and record selection NOT YET AUTHORIZED
seal.freeze_completion_ruling: Owner authorized freeze completion/readiness/seal/countersign; acquisition start remains HOLD
seal.verifier_note: SHA-256 over RFC8785-JCS of manifest_body only; same canonicalization as ADR0043 D-BOX campaign freeze tooling
